prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your Companion to Your Account", "Sign in now to sync your new pet safely across your devices.", "Using your primary account ensures your pet is never lost."]
1: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Your pet is now live on your screen! Here are quick controls to get started.", "Right-click pet for settings and hiding", "Press Alt+P to summon pet to cursor", "Click pet chat bubble to start talking"]
2: ["Select a Ready Pet or Create Custom", "Pick a instantly ready desktop friend or design your own."]
3: ["Log in with your existing account email to keep all previous pets and progress intact."]
4: ["Calibrating Your Pet's Desktop Home...", "Your pet is preparing its cozy spot on your screen.", "Desktop Animation Preview", "Tip: You can move your pet anywhere on your taskbar later!"]
5: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Instant Adopt", "Pick from ready-to-play pet companions in seconds", "Custom Creator", "Turn your real photos into a unique virtual pet"]
6: ["Confirm Your Pet is Visible", "Look at your taskbar or main screen. Can you see your pet walking around?", "Yes! My Pet is Here"]
7: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Use well-lit, forward-facing photos with clear backgrounds for best results."]
8: ["Creating Your Desktop Companion", "Generation takes around 1-2 minutes. You can minimize this window in the meantime.", "We'll send a system alert as soon as your pet wakes up!"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet World", "Adopt a interactive virtual companion that lives right on your computer.", "Welcome Companion"]
